A6 ordinary-suite timing (H7 / OQ-001)

Measured command:
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp go test -count=1 -json ./internal/oracle/a6/...

Measurement: a Python subprocess wrapper used time.monotonic around that command,
parsed Go JSON events and counted passing TestOracle subtests. No environment
values were printed. This was the ordinary suite, without the oracleproof tag.
Start UTC: 2026-10-24T00:27:21Z
End UTC: 2026-10-24T00:27:24Z
Wall seconds, including Go build: 3.207
Go package elapsed seconds: 2.793
Exit code: 0
Inventory subtests passed: 30
Cache policy: -count=1 disables test-result caching; build caches were warm.

Baseline denominator: specs/architecture/consolidation-run/baseline.md,
measured at 96c9ad69aee983ce2b929dd681b6ba43bf920535 on the shared Linux host.
The green warm-up was 444 seconds; the timed run was 523 seconds but failed two
deadline-sensitive internal/agent tests under load. Neither is a quiet-host
clean timed baseline. A6 is 0.72% of the green 444-second observation and 0.61%
of the red 523-second observation. These ratios are indicative, not a claim
about the aggregate oracle overhead or final make test regression.

OQ-001 disposition: measured ordinary A6 time meets the estimated 30-second target.
H7 disposition: this A6 contribution is below 15% of either recorded denominator;
the area/integration gate still owns the aggregate +15% oracle / +25% N4 check.
No portable pass/fail speed threshold is added.

Boundary evidence: the task range adds only internal/oracle/a6 files, all Go
files are test-only, and TestA6AdapterImportBoundary rejects sleep calls and
non-adapter module imports. D32's StateForm check-yaml exclusion is inherited;
this task makes no .pre-commit-config.yaml change.

Negative/isolation assertion-strength review: the additive-only boundary makes
disabling production preconditions inappropriate. Each refusal uses well-formed
flags and an otherwise valid committed fixture; its exact first-precondition
message and exit code are compared, and state-bearing refusals require the full
state to remain byte-identical. W2/W5 vary task status; W9 varies the local merge
ref; I5 varies analysis status; D2-D4 vary leading command whitespace; D5-D7 vary
the real runner file lock with a valid batch record; D8 adds agent identity; R2
omits declared inputs and asserts the command marker is absent. Corresponding
success cases exercise the same boundaries. Thus an earlier unrelated refusal
cannot satisfy their expected outputs. W7 uses real conflicting Git changes
and retains its full persisted failure delta. Merge/reconcile isolation guards
inspect actual effective deferred commands and filesystem runner/index artifacts
before and after. Explicit environment name assertions reject inherited names.
Mutation check: temporarily leaking the synthetic ORACLE_A6_UNRELATED parent
name made TestA6ExplicitEnvironment fail at the intended unexpected-name
assertion (exit 1); the leak was then removed and the focused test passed.
The tagged provenance proof changes one golden byte only in a disposable clone,
requires the real check's unexplained report to name that exact path, and checks
that source bytes remain unchanged.

Clean-code pass: resumed capture/determinism additions reviewed for duplication
against the existing harness and for orphaned symbols. No duplication to extract
and no orphans; no cleanup transformations applied. Generated goldens excluded.
